title: 结点电压法：一个电压源加一个电流源
summary: 9 V 电压源和 5 mA 电流源接在同一个网络上。先量两个结点，再列结点方程解释读数。
description: 结点电压法：选 GND 作参考结点，给其余结点各起一个电压名，对每个结点写 KCL，支路电流用“两端电压差 ÷ 电阻”表示。电流源直接写在方程右边。

cards.title: 哪个结点更高？
text: 照目标电路图搭。**PSU1** `9 V` 经 R1 接结点 **N1**。**PSU2** 当电流源：`12 V`、限流 **`0.005 A`**，+ 接结点 **N2**，− 接 GND。
两台电源要共用一个 GND：**用跳线把上下两条蓝轨连起来**。
**测 N1、N2 对 GND 的电压**。N2 只能经过 R3 和 N1 相连——两个结点哪个更高？

cards.title: 每个结点记一笔账
text: - 把结点电压想成**水位**。水从高水位经过每根水管流向低水位，流量 = 水位差 ÷ 水管的电阻。
- 选 GND 作零水位，给其余结点起名字：这里是 $V_{N1}$ 和 $V_{N2}$。两个未知数，就要两个方程。
- 每个结点：**流出 = 流进**（KCL）。在 N2，电流经 R3 和 R4 流出，电流源把 $I_s$ 推进来：
- 用 V、kΩ、mA 作单位：$\frac{V_{N2} - V_{N1}}{1} + \frac{V_{N2}}{3.3} = 5$。N1 的账照样写（R1 从 9 V 一侧来，R2 到 GND，R3 到 N2），两个方程联立求解。
![](fig:nodes)

cards.title: 量两个结点、两条支路
text: - **万用表**：红表笔先点 N1，再点 N2；黑表笔接 GND。
- **电流表串进 R3 支路**，红表笔在 N1 一侧：图里的箭头就是参考方向。读数可以是负的。
- **电流表串进 R4 支路**，红表笔在 N2 一侧。
- 电路检查通过后填测量题。最后一题用 N2 的 KCL，从你自己的读数算出电流源的电流。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **结点电压法**：选参考结点，每个结点一个电压，对每个结点写 KCL，支路电流写成“电压差 ÷ R”。
- 电流源最好写：它的电流直接放到方程右边。
- 支路电流算出来是负的，只说明箭头猜反了。保留负号，不要去改方程。
- 真实电路里，电流源能把它的结点推得比其他电源都高——直到它自己的电压上限（这里是 PSU2 设的 12 V）。

caption.text: 两个未知结点 N1、N2，GND 是参考。箭头是参考方向：I_3 从 N1 指向 N2，电流源把 I_s 推进 N2。

i18n.en: Two unknown nodes, N1 and N2, with GND as the reference. The arrows are reference directions: I_3 from N1 to N2, and the current source pushes I_s into N2.

en.startNote: **Half-built**: the 9 V source PSU1 and the R1–R4 network are wired. **Why**: the resistor network is a repeated skill; the new thing is a current source on the same circuit. **Your job**: place the second bench supply PSU2 (bottom rails), set it to CC mode at 5 mA, and wire the tn↔bn ground jumper and the two jumpers that inject the current into the node between R3 and R4 (column 13).
en.title: Nodal analysis: one voltage source, one current source
en.summary: A 9 V voltage source and a 5 mA current source share one network. Measure the two nodes first, then write node equations that explain them.
en.description: Nodal analysis: take GND as the reference node, name the voltage of every other node, write KCL at each node with every branch current written as (voltage difference) / resistance. A current source goes straight to the right-hand side.
en.compare:
**Compare**:
- Node equations (V, kΩ, mA): N1: (1/1 + 1/2.2 + 1/1) VN1 − VN2 = 9, i.e. 2.4545 VN1 − VN2 = 9; N2: −VN1 + (1/1 + 1/3.3) VN2 = 5, i.e. −VN1 + 1.3030 VN2 = 5. Solution: **VN1 ≈ 7.61 V, VN2 ≈ 9.68 V**.
- Simulator: VN1 ≈ 7.60 V, VN2 ≈ 9.67 V, source ≈ 4.99 mA (CC mode gives 0.01 mA less than 5 mA, hence slightly lower).
- I_R1 = (9 − 7.60) / 1k ≈ **1.40 mA**; I_R3 = (VN1 − VN2) / 1k ≈ **−2.06 mA** (the current really flows from N2 to N1); I_R4 = 9.67 / 3.3k ≈ **2.93 mA**; KCL at N2: 4.99 = 2.06 + 2.93 ✔.

measurements.explain: Solve the two node equations, 2.4545 VN1 − VN2 = 9 and −VN1 + 1.3030 VN2 = 5: VN1 ≈ 7.6 V.
VN2 ≈ 9.67 V, higher than the 9 V source: the current source lifts its node to whatever voltage it needs (as long as that stays below PSU2's 12 V).

measurements.ask: Ammeter in series with R3, red lead on the N1 side: reading I_R3 (reference N1 → N2)
measurements.explain: I_R3 = (VN1 − VN2) / 1 kΩ ≈ −2.06 mA. The minus sign says the current really flows from N2 to N1.

measurements.ask: Ammeter in series with R4: reading I_R4 (N2 → GND)
KCL at N2 with your two readings gives the source current: Is = I_R4 − I_R3
measurements.explain: Into N2: Is + I_R3; out: I_R4. So Is = I_R4 − I_R3 ≈ 2.93 + 2.06 ≈ 4.99 mA — PSU2's 5 mA (the model gives 0.01 mA less in CC mode).

hints: Two supplies: one on the top rails, one on the bottom rails; join the two blue rails with a jumper as GND.
PSU2: 12 V, current limit 0.005 A; its + goes to N2 (the column R3 and R4 share).
A short jumper across the trench joins the two halves of a column, so you can bring N2 down to the bottom rails.
tests: Node voltages are sensible; the current source delivers its limit
Branch currents have sensible sizes and directions

cards.title: Which node is higher?
text: Build it from the target schematic. **PSU1** `9 V` feeds node **N1** through R1. **PSU2** is a current source: `12 V`, limit **`0.005 A`**, + on node **N2**, − on GND.
Two supplies need one shared GND: **join the two blue rails** with a jumper.
**Measure N1 and N2** against GND. N2 only gets its voltage through N1 and R3 — which of the two is higher?

cards.title: Keep one account per node
text: - Think of node voltages as **water levels**. Water flows through every pipe from the higher level to the lower one, and the flow is the level difference divided by the pipe's resistance.
- Choose GND as the zero level. Give every other node a name: here $V_{N1}$ and $V_{N2}$. Two unknowns, so two equations.
- At each node, **flowing out = flowing in** (KCL). At N2, current leaves through R3 and R4, and the current source pushes $I_s$ in:
- In V, kΩ and mA this is $\frac{V_{N2} - V_{N1}}{1} + \frac{V_{N2}}{3.3} = 5$. Write the account for N1 the same way (R1 from the 9 V side, R2 to GND, R3 to N2) and solve the pair.
![](fig:nodes)

cards.title: Measure two nodes and two branches
text: - **Multimeter**: red lead on N1, then on N2; black lead on GND.
- **Ammeter in R3's branch**, red lead on the N1 side: the arrow in the figure is your reference direction. A negative reading is allowed.
- **Ammeter in R4's branch**, red lead on the N2 side.
- Once the circuit check passes, fill in the questions. The last one uses KCL at N2 to find the source current from your own readings.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Nodal analysis**: reference node, one voltage per node, KCL at each node, branch currents as (voltage difference) / R.
- A current source is the easiest part to write: its current goes straight to the right-hand side.
- A negative branch current only means the guessed arrow points the wrong way. Keep the sign; don't flip the equation.
- In a real circuit a current source can lift its node above every other supply — up to its own voltage ceiling (here PSU2's 12 V).

tests.name: 结点电压合理；电流源输出它的限流值
支路电流的大小和方向合理

measurements.ask: 万用表：N1 对 GND 的电压 VN1
万用表：N2 对 GND 的电压 VN2
measurements.explain: VN2 ≈ 9.67 V，比电压源的 9 V 还高：电流源会把结点推到需要的电压（只要低于 PSU2 设的 12 V）。

measurements.ask: 电流表串进 R3，红表笔在 N1 一侧：读数 I_R3（参考方向 N1 → N2）
measurements.explain: I_R3 = (VN1 − VN2) / 1 kΩ ≈ −2.06 mA。负号说明电流实际从 N2 流向 N1。

measurements.ask: 电流表串进 R4：读数 I_R4（N2 → GND）
用 N2 的 KCL 和你的两个读数算电流源的电流：Is = I_R4 − I_R3
measurements.explain: 流进 N2：Is + I_R3；流出：I_R4。所以 Is = I_R4 − I_R3 ≈ 2.93 + 2.06 ≈ 4.99 mA，就是 PSU2 设的 5 mA（模型在 CC 模式下少 0.01 mA）。

hints: 两台电源：一台用上方电源轨，一台用下方电源轨，两条蓝轨用跳线连起来作为 GND。
PSU2 设 12 V、限流 0.005 A，它的 + 端接 N2（和 R3、R4 共用一列）。
用一根跨凹槽的短跳线把同一列的上下两半连起来，就能把 N2 引到下方的电源轨。
startNote: **半成品**：9 V 电压源 PSU1 和 R1–R4 的网络已经搭好。**为什么**：电阻网络是重复技能；这个实验的新东西是同时接一个电流源。**你要做**：放上第二台稳压电源 PSU2（下方轨道），设成 CC 模式 5 mA，接好 tn↔bn 的地线和把电流注入 R3、R4 之间那个结点（第 13 列）的两根跳线。
